name: CubicBits (he/him)
bio:
CubicBits is an Admin on Silver Springs Survival who prefers to spend his time in-game relaxing, helping out, and enjoying the community. He first found the server through his friend Sparka.

He stayed for the community and the laid-back atmosphere. One of his favorite memories is the first Runecrafting event, and he enjoyed helping with Spooky Springs 2026.

CubicBits’ advice for new players is simple: don’t be afraid to ask the community for help. Outside of Minecraft, he enjoys inFAMOUS and generally takes life one vibe at a time.
history: CubicBits became a Moderator on April 24th, 2020 alongside DrFeesh and LunaPotato, and became an Admin on September 20th, 2023.
